field.title: Title
field.originalHint: DWG, DXF, SKP, 3DS, MAX, OBJ, FBX, 3DM, RVT, JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, HEIC, PDF, AI, PSD — up to 50 MB. An image (JPG, PNG, WebP) is also added as the first preview image.
field.spaceHint: Customers tap the main design to browse designs by space. Leave whole-home designs as "Whole home".

compare.needTwo: At least 2 images are needed to compare.
compare.keyboardHint: Drag the handle or use the left and right arrow keys to compare.
compare.sameImage: You picked the same image twice. Choose a different image to compare.

disabled.needTwo: At least two images are needed to compare.
disabled.unselected: Select two different images for A and B.
disabled.loadFailed: The image could not be loaded. Select another image or try again.
disabled.denied: This image is not available. You may not have access or it is no longer shared.

list.empty: No designs yet. Upload an original file (SKP, PDF, or DWG) to get started.
list.emptyCustomer: No designs have been shared yet.

toast.created: Design uploaded. Customers won’t see it until you make it visible.
toast.versionAddedReconfirm: New version uploaded, so this design now needs reconfirmation. Customers with the confirm right were notified.
toast.previewAutoFailed: The design was created, but its preview image couldn't be added automatically. Add it on the detail page.

preview.empty: No preview images. You can still download the original.
preview.loadFailed: Couldn’t load the image. Choose another image or try again.
preview.cadHint: This format can't be previewed in the browser. Link a preview image instead.

pdf.extracting: Creating an image from PDF page {page}…
pdf.extractFailed: Couldn’t create an image from the PDF page. Upload a page image instead.
pdf.password: Password-protected PDFs cannot be converted. Upload an unlocked PDF or a page image.
pdf.pageOutOfRange: That page does not exist in the PDF. Check the number.

confirm.title: Confirm this design?
confirm.body: This records your agreement to the current version ({no}). You can’t undo a confirmation yourself.
confirm.stale: The content has changed. Refresh and review it again.

state.needsReconfirm: This design changed and needs your confirmation again. Review the current version, then confirm.
state.pmNeedsReconfirm: Waiting for the customer to confirm again. Only the customer can change the confirmation.

reconfirm.title: Request reconfirmation?
reconfirm.body: Enter a reason. The design will be marked as needing reconfirmation and customers with the confirm right will be notified.

publish.hint: Customers will see only the current version and its linked preview images.
publish.title: Share this design with the customer?

version.olderNotice: This is an older version. Customers see only the current version.
version.reconfirmWarning: This design is confirmed. A new version will require reconfirmation and notify the deciding customer.

empty: No designs yet. Upload an original (CAD, 3D, image, or PDF) or a single image to get started.

main.hiddenNotice: The main design is private, so customers cannot see it. Make it public to show it large on the customer design page. Until then customers see the latest public design with an image instead.
main.noPreviewNotice: The main design has no comparison image, so there is nothing to show large on the customer design page. Add a render (JPG, PNG, WebP) under comparison images below. Until then customers see the latest public design with an image instead.
main.setHint: Before setting this as the main design, add a comparison image first. Customers see it large on their design page.

customer.heroHint: Tap the main design to browse designs by space.
customer.spaceEmpty: No public designs in this space yet.
